defect.evidence_quote: However well meant, the candidate drug test Georgia has devised diminishes personal privacy for a symbol’s sake. The Fourth Amendment shields society against that state action.

defect.proposed_fix: Replace “symbol's” with “symbol’s” in the quote; keep the p.322 locator.

reasons: The same sentence appears in the disclosed opinion text at p.322.

residual_risks: If formatting fidelity is required, the source also italicizes “for” in HTML markup.

defect.proposed_fix: Replace the pin-323 quote with the actual p.323 sentence beginning “But where, as in this case...” and set the locator to p.323 / paragraph b415-4.
